introHtml: Neoprene lanyards offer a soft, comfortable feel against the skin, making them ideal for all-day wear at trade shows, conferences, or corporate offices. Unlike standard polyester, neoprene resists stretching and holds vibrant printed logos with sharp detail. The 3/4" Neoprene Lanyard with Plastic Clamshell & O-Ring is a popular choice for badge and ID card attachment. Customize with your company logo in full color for a professional, durable badge holder that employees and attendees will appreciate.
